full_name: Michael Kremer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Harvard University
bio: Michael Kremer is the Gates Professor of Developing Societies in the Department of Economics at Harvard University and a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution. His recent research examines education and health, water, and agriculture in developing countries.
